steps.what: Find and select specialized materials for outside reading assignments
Compile bibliographies by formatting and ordering the selected reading records
Verify references and reading suitability before releasing the bibliography to students

tasks.design: Use native reference formatting associated with {DOCS}, then publish the teacher-checked bibliography through {LMS}. Literature discovery and pedagogical selection remain human; formatting uses verified records rather than generated references.
tasks.previous_blocker: Selected references were manually reformatted and reordered for reading lists.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing reference fields and citation styles can generate the list deterministically.
tasks.still_hard: Political perspectives, reading difficulty and source quality require judgement.
tasks.human_edge: The teacher chooses a balanced, relevant reading selection and verifies its interpretation.
tasks.altitude: Formatting takes less time while reading selection and publication responsibility remain unchanged.

reach.task: Verify bibliographic identity and access routes
reach.learn: Catalogue authority records and stable identifiers

evidence.claim: Native reference formatting can compile a bibliography from verified records; this task-specific saving is an unmeasured estimate.

assumptions: Boundary includes literature selection, bibliography formatting, reference verification and publication; full research synthesis is outside it.

The political science teacher produces selected reading records in s1: author, title, publication year, publication source, DOI or catalogue identifier, verified access link and intended reading order. The teacher also specifies citation style. Capture and verification are counted in s1; unresolved metadata is corrected manually or the item is withheld.
Test native citation and reference-list functions before custom code. Existing automatic formatting earns no new saving; s2 represents currently manual formatting only.
No invented reference or automatically inferred pedagogical suitability is accepted. Source interpretation and access checks retain their full time.
research_questions: Does native formatting reduce work after metadata capture and access checks?

already_counted.description: Reference verification and reading suitability before release

incremental.description: Maintain citation style and repair metadata exceptions

approvals.approved_version: Exact reading list, citation fields, order and access links checked before LMS publication in s3; edits void approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R75 gross25 minus7 upkeep gives net18. Range0-4 assumes existing partial reference formatting and substantial metadata repair; literature selection retains time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Participate in recruitment, registration and placement

steps.what: Discuss student interests and capture information needed for recruitment, registration and placement activities
Assemble checked registration and placement details into the required administrative record
Check the participation record and complete authorized registration and placement contributions

tasks.design: Configure native student administration forms in {OTHER} to assemble the teacher's captured details once. The teacher retains recruitment conversations, record checks and authorized contributions; admission and placement decisions are not automated.
tasks.previous_blocker: Teacher contributions were recopied into separate administrative records.
tasks.enabler_now: Native form fields can populate the required record without another transcription step.
tasks.still_hard: Student circumstances, missing information and appropriate placement require human judgement.
tasks.human_edge: The teacher explains the program and recognizes when a student needs individual guidance.
tasks.altitude: Less repeated record preparation leaves student contact and decision rights unchanged.

reach.task: Coordinate program entry information and student support
reach.learn: Registration boundaries and inclusive student guidance

evidence.claim: Native form population can remove repeated assembly of checked registration details; the design and saving are unmeasured.

assumptions: Boundary is the teacher's participation, excluding institutional admissions decisions, administrator processing and student application effort.

The political science teacher produces checked participation details in s1: student identifier, program, term, contact preference, stated interest, requested registration or placement contribution and source document references. Validation and capture remain counted; missing details are resolved manually rather than inferred.
OTHER denotes student administration software. Test its native forms and field reuse before custom code; no automated admission, ranking or eligibility decision is introduced.

Student submissions and administrator work keep their existing scope; no new mandatory student fields are required. If s2 is already automatic or belongs to administration, remove the claimed teacher saving.
unknowns: Teacher authority in registration and placement
Current duplicate entry and access permissions
National consultation needs for changed staff workflows
research_questions: Is record assembly actually teacher work, and does native reuse save time after validation?

already_counted.description: Record checking and authorized teacher contributions

incremental.description: Maintain form mappings and resolve data exceptions

approvals.approved_version: Exact student, program, term, captured details and teacher contribution checked before internal completion in s3; edits void approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R80 gross20 minus7 upkeep gives net13. Range0-3 assumes limited teacher-owned duplication and existing partial form reuse; student conversations and judgement retain time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Advise student organizations through discussion of their plans, concerns and proposed activities

tasks.design: Keep student organization advising as a conversation. Existing guidance in {DOCS} remains a reference without replacing contextual advice.
tasks.previous_blocker: Advising depends on student aims, interpersonal context and institutional expectations.
tasks.enabler_now: Document search supports reference lookup but does not establish a replacement for advising.
tasks.still_hard: Sensitive disagreements and student autonomy need personal judgement.
tasks.human_edge: The adviser supports students without taking over their organization.
tasks.altitude: Advising time and responsibility remain unchanged.

reach.learn: Facilitating student decisions and recognizing support needs

evidence.claim: Student organization advising remains contextual dialogue; no automation saving is established here.

assumptions: Boundary is advising, excluding student organization administration and event production.
Students present concerns and plans in the conversation; no structured suitability or risk flag is assumed.
Check native document search before considering a new assistant; none is introduced.
Zero upkeep because the advising workflow is unchanged.
unknowns: Nature of organizations and adviser responsibilities
research_questions: Is repeated policy lookup distinct from advising and worth measuring separately?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R100 gross0 upkeep0 net0. Routine planning and sensitive disputes retain direct advising.

steps.what: Define the research question, methods, contribution and funding request for grant proposals
Write grant proposal sections from the researcher-authored brief and funding requirements

loop.purpose: Draft proposal prose within the researcher's settled plan
loop.input: research proposal brief and funding call text
loop.output: grant proposal draft linked to supplied evidence
loop.check: Teacher checks argument, methodological feasibility, factual support, promises and alignment with the call
loop.stop: One revision; unsupported claims or unresolved requirements are written manually
loop.why_not_simpler: Native templates handle headings and limits, while proposal prose needs contextual composition

steps.what: Check the research argument and accept the exact proposal version for institutional review

tasks.design: Start with native funding templates in {DOCS}, then use bounded assistance to draft prose from the teacher's research brief. The teacher checks the whole proposal before institutional review; final submission is outside this drafting authority.
tasks.previous_blocker: Turning a developed research plan into call-specific prose required repeated composition.
tasks.enabler_now: A writing assistant can produce editable sections from a supplied plan and call.
tasks.still_hard: Original research contribution, feasibility and defensible promises remain the researcher's work.
tasks.human_edge: The teacher owns the research question and judges whether the proposal can be delivered.
tasks.altitude: Some composition time shifts to refining the research argument without changing funding or submission rights.

reach.task: Verify literature supporting a research argument
reach.learn: Source provenance and reliable citation metadata

evidence.claim: Bounded grant prose drafting from a researcher-authored plan is plausible assistance; these labour estimates are unmeasured.

assumptions: Boundary is the teacher's own proposal writing, excluding external peer review, institutional approval, budget authorization and funder submission.

The political science teacher produces in s1 question, contribution, methods, limitations, work packages, cited evidence, resource request and call requirements. All research decisions and capture remain counted; absent facts are left unresolved for manual completion.
Test native templates and existing text reuse before adding the loop. Only permitted material enters an approved drafting environment; confidential external proposals are outside scope.
Institutional review remains with existing owners and retains its time. No generated budget commitment or factual claim is accepted without source checking.
research_questions: Does checked drafting save composition time after methodological and factual corrections?

already_counted.description: Review and correction of proposed grant wording

incremental.description: Maintain call-specific drafting instructions and checks
Research support template and access maintenance

approvals.approved_version: Exact proposal text, references, methods and stated resource request accepted for institutional review in s3; changes require renewed checking

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R84 gross16 minus7 upkeep gives net9. Range0-3 assumes novel methods and substantial rewriting; research design and institutional review do not shrink.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Reference formatting, record assembly and proposal prose may take less time; academic selection, student dialogue and research judgement remain with the teacher.
